notes.content: The Music — Liberal Arts Emphasis major is for students who would like to pursue a music degree but are not seeking preparation for the music professions of producing, recording, or music ministry. It can provide an excellent foundation for graduate studies in selected areas of music study and is ideal for students who want a broader liberal arts emphasis with more elective options. It has fewer performance requirements than other music majors because it is not a professionally oriented degree. Helpful Resources: Majors and Information Simpson Catalog Undergrad Admissions Transfer Admission Requirements
notes.contentHtml:
The Music — Liberal Arts Emphasis major is for students who would like to pursue a music degree but are not seeking preparation for the music professions of producing, recording, or music ministry. It can provide an excellent foundation for graduate studies in selected areas of music study and is ideal for students who want a broader liberal arts emphasis with more elective options. It has fewer performance requirements than other music majors because it is not a professionally oriented degree.
